Live experiment

Windows XP in a Browser

I built this experience out of nostalgia and curiosity about what is now possible inside a web browser.

It recreates the journey from the BIOS and startup sequence to a working desktop with applications, movable windows, system sounds, and persistent interface states.

The project required extensive visual referencing, orchestration, testing, and iteration to make the experience feel authentic.

02 / Technical Foundation

B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering

I studied Mechanical Engineering at Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences in Kleve, Germany.

For my bachelor’s thesis at Hamburg University of Applied Sciences, I worked on the construction and commissioning of a three-phase machine test bench. I integrated TwinCAT with MATLAB and Simulink through ADS and EtherCAT, developed a speed controller, and created a graphical interface for controlling and monitoring the system in real time.
